Published in *Biostatistics & Epidemiology*. [doi:10.1080/24709360.2022.2065628](https://doi.org/10.1080/24709360.2022.2065628)

A scan statistic defined over the public transportation network, for rapid detection of infectious disease clusters along real human movement rather than administrative boundaries.
